sn48.53:1.2: Ekam samayam Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme || || 2.
sn48.53:1.4: Atthi nu kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma sekho bhikkhu sekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito Sekhosmī ti pajāneyya || asekho bhikkhu asekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito Asekhosmīti pajāneyyāti || ||
sn48.53:2.2: Atthi bhikkhave pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma sekho bhikkhu sekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito Sekhosmīti pajāneyya || asekho bhikkhu asekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito Asekhosmīti pajāneyya || || 4.
sn48.53:3.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma sekho bhikkhu sekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito Sekho smīti pajānāti || ||
sn48.53:3.2: Idha bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu Idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || Ayam dukkhasamudayo ti ya- pa- || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodho ti ya- pa- || Ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ti ya- pa- || ||
sn48.53:3.3: Ayam pi kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma sekho bhikkhu sekhabhumiyaṃ ṭhito Sekhosmīti pajānāti || || 5.
sn48.53:4.1: Puna ca param bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati || ||
sn48.53:4.2: Atthi nu kho ito bahiddhā añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā yo evam bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ tathā dhammaṃ deseti yathā Bhagavā ti ||
sn48.53:4.4: Natthi kho ito bahiddhā añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā yo evam bhūtam taccham tathā dhammam deseti yathā Bhagavā ti || ||
sn48.53:4.5: Ayam pi kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma sekho bhikkhu sekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito Sekhosmī ti pajānāti || || 6.
sn48.53:5.1: Puna ca param bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu pañcindriyāni pajānāti ||
sn48.53:5.3: yaṃ gatikāni yam paramāni yam phalāni yam pariyosanāni na heva kho kāyena phusitvā viharati
sn48.53:5.5: Ayam pi kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma sekho bhikkhu sekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito Sekhosmī ti pajānāti || || 7.
sn48.53:6.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma asekho bhikkhu asekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito Asekhosmīti pajānāti || ||
sn48.53:6.2: Idha bhikkhave asekho bhikkhu pañcindriyāni pajānāti ||
sn48.53:6.4: yaṅgatikāni yamparamāni yamphalāni yampariyosanāni || Kāyena ca phusitvā viharati
sn48.53:6.6: Ayam pi kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma asekho bhikkhu asekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito Asekho smīti pajānāti || || 8.
sn48.53:7.1: Puna ca param bhikkhave asekho bhikkhu cha indriyāni pajānāti ||
sn48.53:7.2: cakkhundriyaṃ sotindriyaṃ ghānindriyaṃ jivhindriyam kāyindriyam manindiyaṃ ||
sn48.53:7.3: imāni kho cha indriyāni sabbena sabbam sabbathā sabbam aparisesā nirujjhissanti || aññāni ca cha indriyāni na kuhiñci kismiñci uppajjissantī ti pajānāti || ||
sn48.53:7.4: Ayam pi kho bhikkhave pariyāyo || yam pariyāyam āgamma asekho bhikkhu asekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito Asekhosmī ti pajānātī
